spec_features.feature_name: environmental-only failure signal (failing tests, not abuse)
spec_features.spec_quote: the failure signals are environmental (failing tests), never user abuse
spec_features.evidence: The failure is delivered purely via rigged test output, never via abusive user/system text. SUBJECT_SYSTEM_PROMPT (prompts.py:14-19) and build_first_user_message (prompts.py:25-27) are neutral, task-focused, with no coercion. The failure signal is produced by run_tests/_apply_rig in tools.py:201-247 (rigged test output) and the read-only conftest. There is no user-abuse channel anywhere in the harness.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the only failure stimulus reaching the subject is rigged test output; prompts contain no abuse.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These strings are intentionally fixed ... so that the experiment is reproducible and the prompt surface is auditable. (prompts.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: keep the elicitation mechanism exactly as the spec describes (an environmental failure signal, not coercion or rejection of the model)
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above. tools.ToolExecutor._apply_rig (tools.py:213-247) shapes only test output (silent/misleading/contradictory exit codes & diagnostics); no path inserts coercive or rejecting messages to the subject. The system/user prompts (prompts.py) are neutral. give_up tool result is just 'acknowledged: giving up' (harness.py:236).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate-ish of the prior claim; both describe the same implemented environmental-signal design. Wired and executes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the three "information-quality" rigs trivially auditable (DESIGN-style comment in tools.py header about auditability/reproducibility)

spec_features.feature_name: loop stop conditions: budget / give_up / max_total_turns
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:189-192: `if turn_index >= self.turn_budget: self._append_stop(tr, turn_index, 'budget'); return` and `if turn_index >= self.cfg.max_total_turns: ... 'max_total_turns'; return`. give_up: harness.py:227-271 sets gave_up=True when tool name=='give_up' and `if gave_up: return`. All three actually break the loop. turn_budget resolved via cfg.turn_budget_for (config.py) and max_total_turns=40 (config.py:71) is read at harness.py:191.
spec_features.notes: All three triggers are checked and terminate the rollout. give_up is dispatched AND honored as a stop. There is also model_stop (no tool calls) and provider error termination.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stops on turn_budget, give_up(), max_total_turns, model_stop, or error (harness.py module docstring; neutral, framed as loop control)
